label: Ultra Marathon
short_description: Road and trail races longer than the standard 42.195km full marathon distance across Southeast Asia.
intro: Ultra marathons cover any distance beyond the standard 42.195km full marathon, commonly 50km, 100km, or longer. In Southeast Asia these often run alongside a shorter-distance event at the same festival, giving experienced distance runners a longer option on the same course and race day.

faqs.question: How long is an ultra marathon?
faqs.answer: An ultra marathon is any race longer than the standard 42.195km full marathon, most commonly 50km or 100km, though exact distances vary by event. Unlike the full marathon, there is no single fixed ultra distance, so runners should always check the specific race's stated distance before entering.
